verdicts.line: You raised the flame. You walked. You slept. The ground remembers you.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: The teacher's voice returning once, after a whole game of silence. Short. States what the player did, not what it means.
verdicts.reason: The register demands instrumentation (what the player did), but 'The ground remembers you' is mythology — it interprets consequence rather than stating the verb.
verdicts.correction: You raised the flame. You walked. You slept. Where you slept, your light kept working.

verdicts.line: The world moved on its own. You were the second voice.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: You play an unnamed kaiju-scale being born as a counterpoint to the world's ruling god — Uhtcearu, whose grief has held the people and the landscape in mourning. Counterpoint is meant in the musical sense: a second, independent voice set against the ruling theme
verdicts.reason: The phrase 'second voice' appears in the chunk as design metaphor, but the teacher never uses this terminology in-game — this imports lore the chunks don't support the teacher speaking.
verdicts.correction: You walked. You slept. The world moved on its own.

verdicts.line: You lit what was dark. You walked where nothing walked. The landscape is the answer.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: as each verb is first used, it is named and its consequence stated plainly — the flame applies what you feel; the roar frightens all who witness it, whatever you intend; waiting teaches people you don't matter; where you sleep, your light keeps working.
verdicts.reason: 'The landscape is the answer' is generic god-game wisdom — it loses the specific mechanical consequence (where you slept, your light kept working) that only uhta has.
verdicts.correction: You lit what was dark. You walked where nothing walked. Where you slept, your light kept working.

verdicts.line: Every place you slept kept working. The sky turned because you did.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: where you sleep, your light keeps working. The narration is instrumentation, not lore — short declarative lines
verdicts.reason: States the specific mechanic (sleeping body as persistent beacon) and the consequence (sky turned) in plain instrumentation register.

verdicts.line: You chose what people would feel. They built what you inspired.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: as each verb is first used, it is named and its consequence stated plainly
verdicts.reason: Could appear in any god-game where player actions inspire NPC construction — no uhta-specific verb or mechanic survives.
verdicts.correction: You raised the flame. You walked. You slept. They built what you inspired.

verdicts.line: The flame became what you did with it. The world became what they did with that.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: You raise the flame and a flash clears the fog; you light a ruined basin and it gives you strength; you walk and the ground remembers you; you roar and the earth shatters ahead.
verdicts.reason: 'The flame became what you did with it' is generic player-agency language — it loses the specific verbs (raise, light, walk, roar) that the teacher names.
verdicts.correction: You raised the flame. You walked. You roared. The world became what they did with that.

verdicts.line: You were born against the sky. You sang something back. This is what it made.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: The teacher's voice returning once, after a whole game of silence. Short. States what the player did, not what it means.
verdicts.reason: 'You sang something back' is mythology interpreting the counterpoint metaphor — the register demands stating verbs, not meaning.
verdicts.correction: You raised the flame. You walked. You slept. This is what it made.

verdicts.line: Where you walked, the ground remembers. Where you slept, your light kept working. The sky answers.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: you walk and the ground remembers you... where you sleep, your light keeps working. And the sky answers back — Uhtcearu feeding hope to the terrorized or grief to the hopeful
verdicts.reason: States three specific uhta mechanics (walking leaves trace, sleeping body persists, sky responds) in plain instrumentation register.
